doc: One row per function of the original executable (main) and its four overlays (ovl0..ovl3, all loaded at 0x1f18000): addr, image, size in bytes, the ledger system, status, evidence (what the tree shows, written by the scan), note. Addresses, sizes and statuses only: callers, callees and names stay in the private workspace (RULES A5). Statuses: unread, read (cited in docs/ on a line that does not say the function was not read), ported (a `/// orig 0x<addr>` doc comment line in non-test Rust code; overlays `/// orig ovlN 0x<addr>`), tested (the address in a hand-written #[test] function's name or doc comment), verified (the same for an oracle test: it runs the original through kh2-ee, calling Ee or the factory harness directly or through a helper of its file, e.g. the factory's orig_<addr>_matches_the_game; verified over tested over ported over read), not-needed:<sdk|debug|hw|dead|fm>. read/ported/tested/verified are only set by `kh2 ledger scan`; system, not-needed and note are hand-edited. `systems` lists the ledger systems: [id, ladder step of PLAN section 5, sheets/systems.json rows, what]. A systems.json row is closed by a `closed` column or a `validated` text starting with 'closed'; the preflight then rejects any unread or read function of a system mapped to it. Rebuild: `kh2 ledger import` (rows from ../kh2_ps2, seeding, scan); report: `kh2 ledger report`. Note `lv4`: a function start the typed project added (not in the workspace's function sheets).
